source_title: New Open-World MMORPG Officially Confirmed for November 16
source_excerpt:
Spirit Crossing is an upcoming cozy MMORPG scheduled to launch on November 16, 2026, for PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, as well as Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 . The game has been in development for over five years and has held multiple successful playtests on Steam. In addition to Switch and Switch 2 preorders, a free playable demo is also available on Valve's storefront until November 9.
Developer Spry Fox describes Spirit Crossing as "a cozy MMO about making a home in a strange, beautiful, and ever-changing world." Unlike action-oriented MMOs , Spirit Crossing emphasizes co-op play and a no-pressure approach to progression. The game also doesn't force players to interact with strangers. Its unique friendship system gives players full control over who they want to talk to and complete quests with, as well as who they want to ignore.
Spirit Crossing Price and Release Details Confirmed
Genre : Open-world, MMORPG, Simulation
Platforms : PC (Steam, EGS), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2
Following the reveal of a new trailer during the Indie World Showcase , Spirit Crossing is now available for pre-order on the Nintendo eShop for $29.99 USD , which is likely to be the price on PC storefronts as well. No plans to release Spirit Crossing on PlayStation or Xbox have been revealed as of this writing. Ahead of the upcoming launch, Spry Fox's CEO said, "We've spent the last five years developing Spirit Crossing with the mission of providing a welcoming space for anyone craving meaningful connections." The studio has also revealed details about how friendships and MMO interactions will work in the game.
In Spirit Crossing , players will see strangers as silhouettes. In this form, communication is limited, and players cannot read each other's text messages. If they decide to become friends, they can gradually unlock new features, such as gift-giving, teleportation, two-person emotes, and proximity chat. This approach lets players choose who they want to connect with while allowing them to explore the world entirely on their own.

As expected from an MMO role-playing game , Spirit Crossing also emphasizes customization. Players can change their avatars and build homes using a wide range of accent pieces. One interesting feature is that players can stack decorative items on top of each other, a feature more games in the genre need to adopt. When they aren't building their own homes, players can also take part in community projects to help rebuild specific parts of the map and restore them.
One concern gamers might have is whether Spirit Crossing will feature aggressive microtransactions. Developer Spry Fox has addressed these concerns, saying, " We're intentionally avoiding microtransactions in Spirit Crossing ." However, the game will offer an optional paid membership similar to a season pass, which lets players earn extra items or access exclusive features. Fans of cozy multiplayer games may also be interested to know that many in-game cosmetics can be unlocked through regular gameplay.
